notes: Adds an 'Open folder' button beside Settings in the popup. It opens a folder window straight at the run you just downloaded - for example 'Shopee daily report/24082026-Monday-0915' - so you do not have to go looking for it.

One honest limit: Chrome does not let an extension open your normal file manager window at a folder it did not download into. This opens Chrome's own folder window instead. You can see and open every file in it; close it when you are done.
